itens.t: Trump faces midterm verdict with control of Congress at stake
itens.r: American voters head to the polls on Tuesday in high-stakes midterm elections that will determine control of the House of Representatives and crucial Senate seats. The nationwide vote serves as a major referendum on Donald Trump's presidency, testing his political clout and the ability of democratic institutions to withstand executive pressure. Cost of living, immigration, and intense political polarization are driving heavy turnout across the country. Final results could take days to materialize as election officials process millions of mail-in and early ballots.
itens.d:
Donald Trump is confronting a critical midterm electoral verdict with control of the United States Congress hanging in the balance. The upcoming political outcome will determine the legislative majority and overall power dynamics in Washington.

The high-stakes congressional contest serves as a major referendum on the current administration's policies. Voters across the nation will decide which party holds sway over lawmakers in Capitol Hill as campaigns reach their final crucial stages.

itens.t: North Korea claims first test of smaller cluster warheads on cruise missiles
itens.r: North Korea announced it has successfully tested strategic cruise missiles equipped with smaller cluster warheads. Experts warn the development signals operational deployment that could threaten targets across the entire Korean Peninsula.
itens.d:
North Korea tested strategic cruise missiles equipped with cluster warheads on Monday, according to state media reports. The test occurred just days after the country evaluated similar military capabilities on short-range ballistic missiles.

The Korean Central News Agency reported that the recent cruise missile test involved a middle-sized dispersal warhead. State media claimed this specialized weapon system is capable of turning designated targets completely into ashes.

itens.t: James Webb Space Telescope uncovers new clues about interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS
itens.r: Scientists using the James Webb Space Telescope discovered that the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS is composed of ice grains and dust vastly different from typical solar system comets.
itens.d:
Using the James Webb Space Telescope, scientists have discovered that the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS is composed of tiny ice grains mixed with dust. These materials differ significantly from typical comets originating within our own solar system.

Discovered entering the solar system in the summer of 2025, 3I/ATLAS is only the third known interstellar visitor. Researchers believe the object formed within a planet-forming disk around a young star between 10 and 12 billion years ago.

itens.t: Gabriel Medina wins in Cloud 9 to secure surfing victory
itens.r: Three-time world champion Gabriel Medina clinched victory at Cloud 9 after defeating Jack Robinson in a stellar final showdown.
itens.d:
Gabriel Medina secured a major surfing victory at Cloud 9 after defeating Jack Robinson in the final. The three-time world champion successfully eliminated current ranking leader Yago Dora during the semifinal round to advance to the decisive heat.

In other events at the Philippines competition, Luana Silva was eliminated by Carissa Moore, while American surfer Caitlin Simmers triumphed over Isabella Nichols. Medina's strong performance earned him the tournament trophy and the WSL vice-leadership.

itens.t: VIDEO: ESA tests a new crane designed to unload heavy cargo on the Moon
itens.r: This YouTube video explores the European Space Agency's Planetary Robotics Lab, where engineers are testing a scaled lunar crane model capable of lifting up to 1,000 kilograms.
itens.d:
The video covers a scaled model of the ESA Loader lunar crane operating inside the European Space Agency's Planetary Robotics Lab. It demonstrates the crane moving a payload mock-up during testing.

The footage shows features of the full-sized crane, which is engineered to lift up to 1,000 kilograms off a lander like Argonaut and place it up to six meters away. The clip is part of a regular series released on Tuesday and Friday.

itens.t: Child’s measles death marks New York state’s first in 30 years
itens.r: Public health officials confirmed a child's death from measles in New York, marking the state's first such fatality in over three decades amid an ongoing outbreak.
itens.d:
A young child in New York state's Lewis County has died from a measles-associated condition amid an ongoing regional outbreak. Officials confirmed the fatality marks the first known measles-related death in the state in over thirty years.

Governor Kathy Hochul expressed deep sorrow over the tragedy and emphasized that vaccination remains the best protection against the highly contagious disease. The fatality follows a recent State Disaster Emergency declaration and ongoing federal policy discussions regarding immunization schedules.

The newly established Defense Drone Agency replaces the previous Drone Operations Command. This transition aims to enhance the nation's strategic readiness against growing unmanned aerial vehicle threats from the DPRK.

itens.t: NASA’s CHAPEA crew ‘returns’ to Earth after simulated Mars mission
itens.r: Four NASA volunteers successfully emerged from a year-long simulated Mars habitat isolation experiment designed to prepare future human deep-space exploration.
itens.d:
NASA's four-member Crew Health and Performance Exploration Analog crew completed a simulated Mars mission lasting over a year. Crew members spent 378 days managing limited resources, growing crops, and handling communication delays inside a habitat.

The simulation aimed to help researchers understand how astronauts adapt to long-duration space missions. Insights gathered from the analog mission will assist NASA in planning future human habitats on the Moon and Mars.

Data indicates that Chinese embedded AI startups secured billions of yuan in funding during the first half of the year. Industry experts note that hardware profit margins are declining, driving manufacturers to prioritize intelligent software systems in the global tech rivalry.

After a quiet start to the year, Mauricio elevated his performance significantly during the second half of the season. His crucial goals have helped offset attacking absences caused by injuries among his teammates.

itens.t: Brazilian infrastructure receives below-average score in national index
itens.r: A comprehensive index developed by Confea rated Brazilian infrastructure at 56.92 out of 100, highlighting deep structural deficits relative to the nation's economic size.
itens.d:
Brazilian infrastructure received an average score of 56.92 out of 100 on a national evaluation index developed by Confea. The results indicate that the country's transport, logistics, energy, and connectivity sectors fall below expected standards for its economic size.

While mobility indicators averaged 53.84 points, energy and connectivity reached slightly higher marks. Confea's leadership stated that the low overall score reflects a lack of prioritization rather than a simple shortage of financial resources.

Market sentiment flipped following currency depreciation and fiscal uncertainties after the presidential election results. Analysts note that a majority of market participants now anticipate that interest rates will be maintained at their current levels.

Ahead of the meetings in the United Arab Emirates, American negotiators are holding preparatory talks in Brussels with European and NATO representatives. The diplomatic push aims to build upon earlier discussions toward establishing a durable peace agreement.

itens.t: NASA’s Hubble telescope uncovers missing oxygen in nearby dwarf galaxies
itens.r: Astronautical researchers using data from the Hubble Space Telescope have solved a long-standing astronomical mystery concerning depleted oxygen reserves in dwarf galaxies.
itens.d:
NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope has uncovered a cosmic mystery regarding missing oxygen in nearby dwarf galaxies. A research paper published in The Astrophysical Journal details findings from the Galaxies Losing Oxygen via Winds study.

Scientists utilized observational data to analyze galaxy NGC 4449 and other dwarf systems. The research reveals that these smaller galaxies are only able to retain a small fraction of the oxygen produced by their resident stars.

The government's measure prohibits fixed-odds betting operations, including online games and sports betting. While federal ministries and industrial confederations support the ban to protect public welfare, football clubs and sports organizations strongly oppose the measure.

During a Cabinet meeting, the president emphasized that modern cyberattacks pose severe risks to public safety, the economy, and national security. Citing a recent breach involving a cryptocurrency exchange, he urged authorities to improve early detection systems and cross-agency cooperation.

itens.t: Astrônomos descobrem estrela vizinha que deforma atmosfera de Betelgeuse
itens.r: Uma equipe internacional de astrônomos detectou perturbações atmosféricas na supergigante vermelha Betelgeuse causadas pela passagem de uma estrela próxima.
itens.d:
An international team of astronomers has discovered that a nearby star named Siwarha is actively deforming the atmosphere of the red supergiant Betelgeuse. Researchers utilized radio telescopes in Chile to analyze stellar layers across seven different frequencies.

Because Siwarha is too faint to be seen directly, scientists tracked its presence by observing periodic changes in Betelgeuse's shape and temperature. The passing companion star periodically stretches and rounds out the supergiant's extended gas layers.
